author: Kushal
problem: A karate club grades students on a score out of 100. Each belt needs at least a minimum score: black 90, brown 75, green 60 and yellow 40; anyone below 40 stays on white. Return the highest belt a student's score earns.
bug_description: Uses score > minimum instead of score >= minimum, so a score exactly on a belt's minimum gets the belt below.

comments.accurate: Returns the highest belt whose minimum score the student reached
comments.wrong_behavior: Returns the highest belt whose minimum score the student beat
comments.wrong_location: Threshold test verified; the grade list may need sorting from lowest to highest
